items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Eubie Blake and Madison Reid and I worked, called the Bucket of Blood. Now I've got this job in the Bucket of Blood.

ctx.x: Okay, so you're talking about Atlantic City after the summer's over in September. At this point were you staying in Atlantic City in the winter time, too? Were you living there?

Well, no. I'm trying to live there. 'Cause see, I don't want to go back to school, and I don't want to go back to Philadelphia where my people are and all, you see. I'm lost. I don't know what to do. That's right, I'm really lost. I don't know what it's all about. I jumped out of school and followed this girl, you know what I mean. And I got down there, and it was like that song said, 'After you get what you want, you don't want it.' Now I've got it and I run into Charlie Johnson and I think he's the greatest,…

But let me tell you about that. There got to be a place right across from where Eubie Blake and Madison Reid and I worked, called the Bucket of Blood. Now I've got this job in the Bucket of Blood. And this is where, in the wintertime, it
